title: A planner run asked for it gets the whole kit in its first message, keeps the image tool, and the part tool answers every part as already sent
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: On the JA Boxing kit, the first message carries contents, site, pageGroups, pages and every block, each exactly as the part tool answers it, then the brief; every id the tool answers is marked as in the first message.
The tools are still the part tool and the image tool; reading site, a page or a block answers that it was already sent in the first message.

tests: the first message carries contents, the site, the page groups, the pages and every block, then the brief
the part tool answers every part as already in the first message, and the image tool stays
